CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro:
Hah!
I am BLAINE, the red-hot LEADER of CINNABAR GYM!
My fiery POKéMON are all rough and ready with intense heat!
They incinerate all challengers!
Hah! You better have BURN HEAL!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineDefeat:
I have burned down to nothing! Not even ashes remain!
You have earned the VOLCANOBADGE.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_FireBlastIsUltim:
FIRE BLAST is the ultimate fire technique.
Don't waste it on WATER POKéMON.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ExplainVolcanoBa:
Hah!
The VOLCANOBADGE heightens the SPECIAL stats of your POKéMON.
Here, you can have this, too!
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlainePostBattle:
TM38 contains FIRE BLAST. Teach it to FIRE-type POKéMON.
VULPIX or CHARMELEON would be ideal for that move.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikIntro: Do you know how hot POKéMON fire breath can get?
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikPostBattle:
Fire, or to be more precise, combustion…
…Oxygen in the air… Blah, blah, blah, blah…
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnIntro: I was a thief, but I went straight as a TRAINER.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnPostBattle: I get this uncontrollable urge to steal other people's POKéMON.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryIntro: I've studied POKéMON thoroughly. You can't win!
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryPostBattle: My theories are too complicated for you to understand.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonIntro: I like using FIRE-type POKéMON. I just do.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonPostBattle: I wish there were a thief POKéMON. I'd use that!
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekIntro: I know why BLAINE became a TRAINER.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekPostBattle:
Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost in the mountains but good.
Night fell when a fiery bird POKéMON appeared.
Its light allowed BLAINE to find his way down safely.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyIntro: I've been to many GYMS, but this one best suits my style.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyPostBattle: PONYTA, NINETALES… Those are popular FIRE POKéMON.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacPostBattle:
Water beats fire, of course.
But fire melts ice, so the FIRE type beats ICE-type POKéMON.
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice:
Yo! Champ in the making!
The hotheaded BLAINE is a FIRE POKéMON pro.
Douse his spirits with water!
You'd better take some BURN HEALS, too.

CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PokemonQuizRules:
POKéMON Quiz!
Get it right, and the door opens to the next room.
Get it wrong, and face a TRAINER!
If you want to conserve your POKéMON for the GYM LEADER…
Then get it right! Here we go!
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion2: There are nine certified POKéMON LEAGUE BADGES?
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion4: Are electric moves effective against GROUND-type POKéMON?
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion5: POKéMON of the same kind and level are not identical?
CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_CorrectGoOnThrou:
You're absolutely correct!
Go on through!
